name: Miffy curved crown/chin pitch v36 · non-production

headPitchProfile.note: The same head ellipsoid used for yaw supplies the vertical surface arc and side curvature. +pitch starts at the chin and increasingly presses chin/mouth/nose/eyes up toward a held crown. -pitch starts at the crown and increasingly presses forehead/eyes/nose/mouth down toward a held chin. Both decrease visible forehead height. Existing yaw inverse sampler carries all face pixels and detached eye overlays together.

headPitch.faceOwner: face layer with eye overlays, combined in the existing yaw sampler
headPitch.driver: manual pitch slider; +100 up and -100 down
headPitch.note: Only v36 changes hair pitch gains by direction: low up-follow keeps the crown near neutral; stronger down-follow prevents the painted hairline from defeating forehead compression. Neck retains v34 behavior.

limits: Pending task-scoped curved-pitch A/B review against v34/v35; not a default or public candidate.
Opposite end is assumed held during each directional push. This is an art-directed surface arc, not a physical 3D pitch or hidden under-chin reconstruction.
Review intermediate and endpoint poses, scalp/hairline, lower jaw/neck seam, blink/gaze and yaw/pitch corners.
